item.title: South Korean Ship Hit in Hormuz, Explodes and Catches Fire… Government Says “No Casualties” (호르무즈 한국선박 피격돼 폭발·화재…정부 “인명 피해는 없어”)
item.description:
On the night of the 4th, the same day the United States launched "Operation Freedom" (Plan of Liberation) to facilitate the passage of ships through the Strait of Hormuz, a South Korean vessel experienced an explosion followed by a fire. While no casualties have been reported so far, the government is investigating whether this was a deliberate attack. (미국이 호르무즈해협 선박 통과를 위한 ‘프로젝트 프리덤’(해방 계획) 작전을 개시한 4일 밤 한국 선박에서 폭발과 함께 화재가 일어났다. 일단 인명 피해는 없는 것으로 파악됐지만, 정부는 고의적 공격 여부 등을 확인 중이다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that around 8:40 PM that evening, an explosion and subsequent fire occurred aboard the cargo ship HMM NAMU, which was anchored near the waters of the United Arab Emirates inside the Strait of Hormuz. According to the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, the explosion is presumed to have occurred on the port side of the engine room while the vessel was anchored outside the port limits of Umm Al Quwain. The ship, though Panamanian-flagged, is operated by a South Korean shipping company and carries six South Korean crew members and 18 foreign crew members, with no casualties reported. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is currently verifying the cause of the explosion and fire as well as the extent of the damage. ( 외교부는 이날 저녁 8시40분께 호르무즈해협 안쪽 아랍에미리트 인근 해역에 정박 중이던 화물선 에이치엠엠 나무(HMM NAMU)호에서 폭발과 함께 화재가 발생했다고 밝혔다. 해양수산부에 따르면 움알쿠와인항 항계 밖 수역에 정박 중이던 이 선박의 기관실 좌현에서 폭발이 일어난 것으로 추정된다. 파나마 국적이지만 우리 선사가 운용 중인 이 선박에는 한국 국적 선원 6명과 외국 국적 선원 18명이 탑승 중이며, 인명 피해는 없는 것으로 파악됐다. 외교부는 폭발과 화재 발생의 원인과 구체 피해 현황 등을 확인 중이다.)

Cheong Wa Dae also stated that day, “We are confirming the cause of the fire on the vessel, and it has been verified that there are currently no casualties among the South Korean crew.” In connection with this, a senior government official said, “The vessel is believed to have been hit,” adding, “It is necessary to verify what type of weapon caused the damage and whether it was an intentional attack.” ( 청와대도 이날 “해당 선박의 화재 원인을 확인 중이며 현재 한국 승선원의 피해는 없는 것으로 확인됐다”고 밝혔다. 이와 관련해 정부 고위관계자는 “해당 선박은 피격당한 것으로 파악되고 있다”며 “어떤 무기 등으로 피해가 발생했는지 고의적 공격에 의한 것인지 등은 확인이 필요하다”고 말했다.)

A Ministry of Foreign Affairs official stated, “The government will closely communicate with relevant countries on this matter and take necessary measures to ensure the safety of our ships and crew inside the Strait of Hormuz.” It was reported that the government has requested rescue and other assistance from relevant countries, including the United Arab Emirates. ( 외교부 관계자는 “정부는 금번 사안에 대해 관련국들과 긴밀히 소통하며 호르무즈해협 내측의 우리 선박·선원의 안전을 위해 필요한 조치를 취해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다. 정부는 아랍에미리트 등 관련국에 구조 등 협조 요청을 한 것으로 알려졌다.)

According to the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, a total of 26 South Korean-flagged vessels are currently stranded inside the Strait of Hormuz. Among them, nine are oil tankers, and the remaining include car carriers. The number of South Korean crew members aboard South Korean-flagged ships is 123, and including 37 South Korean crew members on foreign-flagged vessels, the total number of South Korean crew members in the strait is 160. ( 해양수산부에 따르면 현재 호르무즈해협 안쪽에 발이 묶인 한국 국적 선박은 모두 26척이다. 이 가운데 유조선은 9척이며 나머지 선박들엔 자동차 운반선도 포함돼 있다. 한국 국적 선박에 승선 중인 한국인 선원은 123명이고, 외국 국적 선박에 타고 있는 한국인 선원 37명을 포함하면 해협 내 한국인 선원은 모두 160명이다.)

The attack on the South Korean ship occurred amid heightened tensions after U.S. President Donald Trump announced the launch of "Operation Freedom" to support the evacuation of ships trapped in the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran warned it would attack if U.S. forces attempted to enter the strait. The U.S. Central Command stated it would deploy guided-missile destroyers, over 100 aircraft, and 15,000 troops for Operation Freedom, which began on the morning of the 4th Middle East time (afternoon of the 4th Korea time). Around the time the U.S. launched Operation Freedom, oil tankers and cargo ships in the Strait of Hormuz were attacked, apparently by Iranian forces. The UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the attack on an oil tanker owned by the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) by two Iranian drones as a "terrorist act." ( 이날 한국 선박 피격은 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 호르무즈해협에 갇힌 선박들의 대피를 지원하는 ‘프로젝트 프리덤’을 개시하겠다고 밝히고, 이란이 미군의 해협 진입 시도 땐 공격하겠다고 경고해 긴장이 고조된 가운데 발생했다. 미국 중부사령부는 프로젝트 프리덤에 유도 미사일 구축함, 100대 이상의 항공기, 병력 1만5천명을 투입하겠다고 밝히고 중동시각 기준 4일 오전(한국시각 4일 오후) 작전을 개시했다. 미국이 프로젝트 프리덤 작전을 개시하기 전후로 호르무즈해협에서는 유조선과 화물선이 이란 쪽이 가한 것으로 보이는 공격을 받았다. 아랍에미리트 외교부는 이날 아부다비국영석유공사(ADNOC) 소속 유조선을 이란의 무인기 2대가 공격했다며 “테러 행위”라고 규탄했다.)

Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr Jang Ye-ji, Reporter penj@hani.co.kr Kim Ji-hoon, Reporter watchdog@hani.co.kr Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr 장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr 김지훈 기자 watchdog@hani.co.kr 서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Min-sik Selected as People Power Party Candidate for Busan Buk-gu Gap… Three-Way Race with Ha Jung-woo and Han Dong-hoon (국힘 부산 북갑 후보에 박민식…하정우-한동훈과 3파전)
item.description:
Former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-sik was elected on the 5th as the People Power Party candidate for the Busan Buk-gu Gap by-election, held alongside the June 3 local elections. This sets up a three-way race with Ha Jung-woo of the Democratic Party of Korea and independent former leader Han Dong-hoon. (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 국민의힘 후보에 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관이 5일 선출됐다. 하정우 더불어민주당 후보, 무소속 한동훈 전 대표와 3자 구도를 형성하게 됐다.)

The People Power Party's Nomination Management Committee announced this after combining public opinion polls and party member voting results from the primary held on the 3rd and 4th, stating that Park outperformed former KBS journalist Lee Young-pung. (국민의힘 공천관리위원회는 지난 3∼4일 진행된 국민 여론조사와 당원 투표 결과를 합산한 경선에서 이영풍 전 한국방송(KBS) 기자를 앞섰다며 이렇게 발표했다.)

Candidate Park, a former prosecutor, served as a two-term lawmaker for Busan Buk-gu and Gangseo-gu Gap (18th and 19th assemblies) and was the first Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration. (검사 출신인 박 후보는 제18·19대 부산 북·강서갑에서 재선 의원으로 일했고 윤석열 정부에서 초대 국가보훈부 장관을 역임했다.)

Within and outside the People Power Party, there are calls for a unification between Candidate Park and former leader Han Dong-hoon to secure victory in Busan Buk-gu Gap, but former Minister Park maintains the position that "there will be no unification." (국민의힘 안팎에서는 부산 북갑 승리를 위해 박 후보와 한 전 대표 간의 단일화가 필요하다는 목소리가 나오지만, 박 전 장관은 ‘단일화는 없다’는 입장이다.)

item.title: Three generals dismissed, one removed over martial law troop mobilization: Defense Ministry imposes heavy disciplinary measures (계엄군 동원 장성 3명 파면·1명 해임…국방부 중징계 단행)
item.description:
Generals suspected of mobilizing martial law troops to the National Election Commission and other locations during the December 3 insurrection have been dismissed. (12·3 내란 당시 중앙선거관리위원회 등에 계엄군 병력을 동원한 혐의를 받는 장성들이 파면됐다.)

The Ministry of National Defense announced on the 5th, "Four generals and field-grade officers indicted by the Defense Special Investigation Headquarters on charges of involvement in the December 3 insurrection have been subject to heavy disciplinary action for violating the duty to comply with laws and regulations, and the duty of good faith." Three individuals—former Brigadier General Kim Jeong-geun, former commander of the 3rd Airborne Brigade of the Special Warfare Command; former Brigadier General-designate An Moo-seong, former commander of the 9th Airborne Brigade of the Special Warfare Command; and Colonel Kim Se-woon, former commander of the Special Operations Aviation Unit—were dismissed, while Colonel Kim Sang-yong, former deputy director of the Defense Ministry's Investigation Headquarters, was removed from his position. The Defense Ministry held a disciplinary committee for these individuals on the 15th of last month. (국방부는 5일 “12·3 내란 사건에 연루된 혐의로 국방특별수사본부에서 기소한 장성·영관급 장교 4명을 법령준수의무위반, 성실의무위반으로 중징계 처분했다”고 밝혔다. 김정근 전 특전사 제3공수여단장(준장)과 안무성 전 특전사 9공수여단장(준장 진급예정자), 김세운 전 특수작전항공단장(대령) 등 3명은 파면됐고, 김상용 국방부 조사본부 차장(대령)은 해임 처분을 받았다. 국방부는 지난달 15일 이들에 대한 징계위원회를 개최했다.)

Former Brigade Commander Kim Jeong-geun is accused of deploying troops to the National Election Commission under the orders of former Special Warfare Commander Kwak Jong-geun during the martial law period. Former Brigade Commander An Moo-seong is accused of ordering 141 and 57 members of his respective units to the Election Commission's Gwanak building and the polling firm "Kkot," respectively, to occupy the buildings. Colonel Kim Se-woon is investigated for mobilizing 24 pilots from his aviation unit to deploy 12 helicopters, allowing 197 members of the 707 Special Mission Group to enter the National Assembly grounds. Former Deputy Director Kim Sang-yong is accused of organizing 100 personnel from the Defense Ministry's Investigation Headquarters into a joint anti-state force arrest team. (김정근 전 여단장은 비상계엄 때 곽종근 전 특수사령관의 명령으로 중앙선거관리위원회에 병력을 출동시킨 혐의를 받는다. 안무성 전 여단장은 선관위 관악청사와 여론조사 꽃에 각각 소속 부대원 141명과 57명을 보내 건물 점거를 지시한 혐의를 받는다. 김세운 전 단장은 항공단 소속 24명의 조종사에게 헬기 12대를 동원해 707특수임무단 소속 부대원 197명을 국회 경내로 들어가게 한 것으로 조사됐다. 김상용 전 차장은 반국가세력 합동체포조에 국방부 조사본부 인원 100명을 편성한 혐의를 받는다.)

Previously, the Defense Ministry's Defense Special Investigation Headquarters indicted these four individuals on charges including engaging in essential duties for insurrection and obstruction of the exercise of rights through abuse of authority. (앞서 국방부 국방특별수사본부는 이들 4명을 내란중요임무종사와 직권남용권리행사 방해 등의 혐의로 기소했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Foreign Ministry: “All Crew on Exploded Vessel Safe… Whether It Was an Iranian Attack Must Be Investigated” (외교부 “폭발 선박 선원 모두 무사…이란 공격 여부, 조사해 봐야”)
item.description:
The Foreign Ministry announced that all Korean and foreign crew members aboard a Korean vessel that suffered an explosion and fire while anchored in the Strait of Hormuz are safe. The government decided to investigate the exact cause of the explosion after towing the vessel to a nearby port. (호르무즈해협에 정박해 있다가 폭발과 화재가 일어난 한국 선박에 있던 한국인과 외국인 선원 모두 무사하다고 외교부가 밝혔다. 정부는 인근 항구로 이 선박을 예인한 뒤 정확한 폭발 원인을 조사하기로 했다.)

On the 5th, the Foreign Ministry stated that as of the night of the 4th, all 24 crew members aboard the Korean-operated vessel HMM NAMU, including 6 Korean nationals who were on board when an explosion and fire occurred while anchored in the Strait of Hormuz, were confirmed to have suffered no harm. The fire on the vessel has been extinguished, and no additional damage has been identified. (외교부는 4일 밤 호르무즈해협에 정박해 있다가 폭발과 화재가 일어난 한국 운영 선박 에이치엠엠 나무(HMM NAMU)호에 탑승 중이던 우리 국적 선원 6명을 포함한 전체 선원 24명 모두 피해를 입지 않은 것으로 확인했다고 5일 밝혔다. 선박의 화재 진압도 완료됐고 추가 피해는 없는 것으로 파악됐다.)

At approximately 8:40 PM Korean time on the 4th, an explosion and fire occurred on a cargo ship operated by Korean shipping company HMM in waters near the United Arab Emirates (UAE) within the Strait of Hormuz. This incident took place amid a situation where the United States initiated ‘Project Freedom’ (Operation Liberation) on the night of the 4th, vowing to extricate vessels trapped in the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran, claiming a ‘ceasefire violation,’ retaliated. US President Donald Trump posted directly on Truth Social that night, stating, “Iran attacked unrelated countries, including a Korean cargo ship,” and argued, “It seems time for Korea to join this operation.” (한국 시각으로 4일 오후 8시40분께 호르무즈 해협 내 아랍에미리트(UAE) 인근 해역에서 한국 해운사 HMM이 운용하는 화물선에서 폭발·화재가 발생했다. 이번 사건은 미국이 호르무즈해협에 갇힌 선박들을 탈출시키겠다며 4일 밤 ‘프로젝트 프리덤’(해방 계획) 작전을 개시하고 이란이 ‘휴전 위반’이라고 반발하며 반격에 나서는 상황에서 벌어졌다. 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 이날 밤 트루스 소셜에 직접 글을 올려 “이란이 한국 화물선을 포함해 관련 없는 국가들을 공격했다”면서 “이제는 한국이 이 작전에 참여할 때가 된 것 같다”고 주장했다.)

However, the government maintains that the exact cause of the accident, including whether it resulted from an Iranian attack, requires investigation. The Foreign Ministry stated, “Whether the vessel is capable of normal navigation is uncertain. After towing it to a nearby port, we will assess the damage and plan repairs. The exact cause of the accident can only be determined during the process of inspecting the damage after towing.” A tugboat is currently being arranged, but specific towing schedules are not yet set, suggesting it may take time for the government to officially announce the precise cause of the accident. (하지만, 정부는 이번 사건이 이란의 공격으로 인한 것인지 등 정확한 사고원인은 조사를 해야한다는 입장이다. 외교부는 “이 선박이 정상적으로 운항 가능한지 여부는 불확실한 상태이며, 인근 항구로 예인한 뒤 피해 상태 등을 확인하고 수리 예정”이라면서 “정확한 사고원인은 선박 예인 후 피해 상태를 확인하는 과정에서 파악 가능할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 현재 예인선을 수배 중이며 구체적인 예인 일정은 아직 미정인 상태여서, 정부가 정확한 사고 원인을 공식 발표하기까지는 시간이 걸릴 것으로 보인다.)

Meanwhile, the Foreign Ministry convened a meeting of the Overseas Citizens Protection Headquarters at midnight on the 5th regarding the explosion and fire incident involving the Korean vessel in the Strait of Hormuz. The meeting, chaired by Second Vice Minister Kim Jin-a, was attended by seven diplomatic missions in the Middle East and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries. During the meeting, Vice Minister Kim expressed deep concern that damage had occurred to a Korean vessel in the Strait of Hormuz for the first time since the outbreak of the Middle East war. He noted that while fortunately there were no casualties this time, it is necessary to identify the cause and work to prevent recurrence, emphasizing the importance of being fully prepared to take swift action whenever needed to protect the lives and safety of Korean sailors. (한편 외교부는 이번 호르무즈해협 내 한국 선박에 폭발·화재 사건에 대해 5일 0시에 재외국민보호대책본부 회의를 개최했다. 회의는 김진아 2차관 주재로 열렸으며 중동 지역 7개 공관과 해양수산부가 참석했다. 회의에서 김 차관은 중동 전쟁 발발 이후 처음으로 호르무즈해협 내에서 한국 선박에 피해가 발생한 데 대해 깊은 우려를 표했다. 이어 다행히 이번에는 인명 피해가 없었지만, 원인 파악과 함께 재발 방지 노력이 필요하다며 언제든지 한국 선원의 생명과 안전을 보호하기 위해 필요한 조처를 신속하게 취할 수 있도록 만반의 준비를 해두는 게 중요하다고 강조했다.)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo on 'Hand Wiping' Controversy: "I Personally Apologized to the Vendor… Even Received Encouragement to 'Stay Strong'" (‘손털기’ 논란 하정우 “상인분께 직접 사과…‘괜찮다’ 격려까지”)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Busan's Buk-gu Gap in the June 3 by-election, who recently faced controversy over 'wiping his hand after a handshake,' stated, "I personally visited the person involved to offer my greeting, and even received encouragement, with them saying, 'It's okay, do your best.'" (최근 ‘악수 뒤 손 털기’ 논란이 일었던 6·3 국회의원 보궐선거 부산 북갑 하정우 더불어민주당 후보가 “당사자분을 직접 찾아가 인사드렸고 ‘괜찮다, 열심히 해라’라는 격려까지 받았다”고 밝혔다.)

Candidate Ha said this in an interview with Busan CBS on the 4th, adding, "Since I'm new to politics, I think there are certainly areas where I fall short." <<> Previously, on the 29th of last month, after resigning from his position as Senior Presidential Secretary for AI Future Planning at the Blue House, Candidate Ha visited Gupo Market in Buk-gu, Busan, as his first schedule. During this visit, he was captured shaking hands with vendors and then rubbing his hands together or making a motion as if wiping them. As the controversy grew, Candidate Ha held a press conference the following day, explaining, "I shook hands with hundreds to nearly a thousand people for the first time. After it was all over, my hands felt numb, so I think I made an unconscious motion." <<> Candidate Ha also apologized again regarding the subsequent controversy over the so-called 'oppa remark.' He said, "I told the child and their parents that I am truly sorry; I sent a message and genuinely feel that way. In the end, I think the key is for me to pay a bit more attention, maintain a humbler attitude, take a lower stance, and focus on resolving things." On the 3rd, Democratic Party Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, while campaigning for Candidate Ha at Gupo Market, said to a first-grade elementary school girl, "What grade are you in? Try calling Jeong-woo here 'oppa'." When the child replied, "I'm in first grade," Representative Jeong said, "Here, Jeong-woo oppa," and Candidate Ha also responded with "Oppa." Afterward, the child said "Oppa," and they took a commemorative photo. <<> Regarding this, opposition figures criticized the attitude of Representative Jeong and Candidate Ha toward the child as inappropriate. That night, Representative Jeong issued a statement saying, "I am sorry to the child and their parents, who must have been hurt as the child was placed at the center of controversy." Candidate Ha also apologized to the child and their parents. <<> Meanwhile, when asked, "What do you see as the most important variable in this election?" Candidate Ha replied, "Many people see the opposition candidate unification as a variable," but added, "If I can convincingly show how the vision for Buk-gu's future over the next decade will change, I believe it could become a winning strategy regardless of unification." <<> Candidate Ha emphasized, "What's important for Buk-gu's development is not ideological values, but how we can open up the future, create progressive alternatives, and present solutions—and I think I have the greatest strength in that area. Aren't I the 'work expert' recognized by President Lee Jae-myung, and 'Ha GPT' (GPT, a nickname for Secretary Ha)?" <<> Reporter Lee Yu-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr ( 하 후보는 4일 부산 시비에스(CBS)와의 인터뷰에서 “아무래도 제가 정치가 처음이다 보니까 부족한 부분들이 틀림없이 있는 것 같다”며 이같이 말했다. )

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Draws Line on Alliance with Expelled Han Dong-hoon: "A Different Dimension from Other Parties" (장동혁, 제명한 한동훈과 연대 선 그어…“다른 당과는 다른 차원”)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk on the 5th effectively declined a potential alliance with former leader Han Dong-hoon, who is running as an independent candidate in the Busan North Gap by-election, stating, "An alliance with a person who was expelled is clearly a matter of a different dimension than an alliance with other parties." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 5일 부산 북갑 국회의원 재보궐선거에 무소속 후보로 출마한 한동훈 전 대표와의 단일화에 대해 “제명했던 인사에 대한 연대는 다른 당과의 연대와는 분명히 다른 차원의 문제”라고 사실상 거부 의사를 밝혔다.)

During a press briefing held at the National Assembly, Rep. Jang said, "This was an issue where the party maintained its principles and decided on expulsion." Earlier in January, the PPP had expelled Han for allegedly damaging the party's reputation and manipulating party opinion through the so-called 'party member bulletin board incident.' Regarding Rep. Han Ji-ah, a pro-Han Dong-hoon figure who visited Busan to support the former leader, Rep. Jang said, "A person who became a member of the National Assembly after receiving the party's nomination and support from party members has a role and responsibility," adding, "We will accurately clarify the facts regarding the various situations currently unfolding and take necessary measures afterwards." However, he noted, "I have not yet ordered an investigation by the party's audit office." <<> When asked about the "low approval rating of the PPP" during the briefing, Rep. Jang countered, "That expression is very ambiguous," explaining, "Local elections are about selecting candidates in each region. More important than nationwide approval ratings are the ratings specific to each region and their trends. Assuming a blanket 'low approval rating' is difficult to accept." He also showed signs of discomfort, stating, "I cannot agree with the premise that (the internal) division started with the expulsion of Han Dong-hoon, and that it is the sole cause of all the current divisions in our party." In a telephone survey conducted by Gallup Korea from the 28th to the 30th of last month, the PPP's approval rating stood at 21%, less than half of the Democratic Party of Korea's rating (46%). By region, the PPP received lower support than the Democratic Party in all areas except Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province (for details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). <<> Regarding the controversy over whether former Rep. Jeong Jin-seok, who has declared his candidacy in the Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang by-election in South Chungcheong Province, will receive the party's nomination, Rep. Jang said, "We will proceed with the nomination process in a way that is acceptable to the public and ensures victory in the overall election." Earlier, the PPP's Nomination Management Committee stated on the 4th that it would postpone the decision on Jeong's nomination until after the party's ethics committee ruling. Former Rep. Jeong, who served as the chief of staff to former President Yoon Suk Yeol when martial law was declared on December 3rd, has been indicted on charges of engaging in crucial duties related to insurrection. <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (장 대표는 이날 국회에서 기자간담회를 열고 “당이 원칙을 가지고 제명했던 사안”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 앞서 국민의힘은 지난 1월 이른바 ‘당원게시판 사건’으로 당의 명예를 훼손하고 당 여론을 조작했다며 한 전 대표를 제명한 바 있다. 장 대표는 또 친한동훈계인 한지아 의원이 부산을 찾아 한 전 대표를 지원한 데 대해서 “당의 공천을 받아서 당원들의 지지를 받아서 국회의원이 된 사람의 역할과 책임이 있다”며 “지금 일어나고 있는 여러 상황에 대해서 정확하게 사실관계를 밝히고 그 이후에 필요한 조치를 하겠다”고 했다. 다만 일단 “당무감사실에 조사를 지시한 건 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil "If My Hometown Were Busan, I'd Like to Run and Punish Him"… Han Dong-hoon "That's Just Bluster" (송영길 “고향이 부산이면 출마해 응징하고파”…한동훈 “허세”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil, the Democratic Party candidate for the by-election in Yeonsu-gu Gap, Incheon, said on the 5th, "Candidate Han Dong-hoon is active in Busan, and if my hometown were truly Busan, I would have volunteered to run there to punish him. I feel so sad watching him carry on like that." In response, Han Dong-hoon, the independent candidate for Buk-gu Gap, Busan, retorted, "A coward who can't even speak up while kowtowing to President Lee Jae-myung and just puts on a show of bravado is no match for me." <<> This back-and-forth stemmed from Song’s remarks that day on SBS’s 'Kim Tae-hyun's Politics Show' regarding the 'Special Act on Uncovering the Truth Behind the Yoon Suk-yeol Administration's Manipulated Indictments.' Song said, "I question whether there's a need to make this a point of contention in the current local elections. Elections are not a time for calm discussion, as everything turns into a political offensive, so it's not an ideal situation to discuss legislation calmly." <<> Then, on the issue of granting the special counsel the authority to dismiss indictments, he stated, "I'll look into the detailed process once I enter the National Assembly. Former Ssangbangwool Group Chairman Kim Seong-tae also received a dismissal of his indictment in court due to manipulated charges. That's because the prosecution filed a duplicate indictment to entrap candidate Lee Jae-myung." <<> In response, Han posted on Facebook, saying, "When the host asked Song for his stance on the special counsel law, he evaded the question by saying 'I'm not sure,' then suddenly turned his sword on me. He said he would 'punish' me, but I will win in Buk-gu Gap and punish the constitutional destruction of the Lee Jae-myung regime and cowardly old-style politics like Song Young-gil's." <<> Previously, in 2024, after former Chairman Kim received a guilty verdict in the first trial for violating the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, the prosecution deemed the remittances to North Korea as third-party bribes for President Lee Jae-myung and others and filed an additional indictment against Kim. In February, the Suwon District Court dismissed the indictment due to the duplicate prosecution. <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (송영길 더불어민주당 인천 연수갑 보궐선거 후보가 5일 “한동훈 후보가 부산에 나와 있는데, 정말 제가 고향이 부산이었으면 자원해서 부산에 출마해 한동훈을 응징하고 싶었다”며 “저 떠들고 있는 모습이 안타까워 죽겠다”고 했다. 이에 한동훈 부산북갑 무소속 후보는 “이재명 대통령 눈치보느라 찍소리도 못하면서 허세나 부리는 비겁한 사람은 제 상대가 되지 못한다”고 맞받았다.)

item.title: Cheong Wa Dae Holds Response Meeting on ‘Hormuz Vessel’ Fire… Chaired by Chief of Staff (청와대, ‘호르무즈 선박’ 화재 대응회의…비서실장 주재)
item.description:
On the 5th, Cheong Wa Dae held a response meeting regarding the fire on our vessel in the Hormuz waters, chaired by Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik. (청와대가 5일 강훈식 대통령비서실장 주재로 호르무즈 해상의 우리 선박 화재와 관련한 대응회의를 열었다.)

Senior Press Secretary Kang Yoo-jung of Cheong Wa Dae stated, “A meeting chaired by the Chief of Staff to discuss the inspection and response to the vessel fire that occurred the previous day on the Hormuz waters was held from 12:30 PM today.” The meeting was attended by Kim Sang-ho, Director of the National Crisis Management Center; Lee Hyun, Maritime Affairs Secretary; and Kim Jung-woo, Director of the National Situation Room. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 “전날 발생한 호르무즈 해상 선박 화재 관련 점검 및 대처를 논의하는 비서실장 주재 회의가 오늘 낮 12시30분부터 열렸다”고 밝혔다. 이날 회의에는 김상호 국가위기관리센터장, 이현 해수비서관, 김정우 국정상황실장 등이 참석했다.)

At around 8:40 PM on the 4th (Korean time), an explosion and subsequent fire occurred on one vessel operated by a Korean shipping company while it was anchored near the United Arab Emirates (UAE) inside the Strait of Hormuz. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that day, “It has been confirmed that all 24 crew members, including six Korean sailors aboard the HMM NAMU, have suffered no harm,” adding, “The exact cause of the accident is expected to be identified during the process of inspecting the damage after the vessel is towed.” (지난 4일 오후 8시40분께(한국시각) 호르무즈해협 내측 아랍에미리트(UAE) 인근 해역에 정박 중이던 한국 선사 운용 선박 1척에서 폭발과 함께 화재가 발생했다. 외교부는 이날 “에이치엠엠 나무(HMM NAMU)호에 탑승 중이던 우리 국적 선원 6명을 포함한 전체 선원 24명 모두 피해를 입지 않은 것으로 확인됐다”며 “정확한 사고원인은 선박 예인 후 피해 상태를 확인하는 과정에서 파악 가능할 것으로 보인다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Won-oh "Completing pediatric care system," Oh Se-hoon "Doubling Seoul-style kids' cafes" (정원오 “소아진료체계 완성” 오세훈 “서울형 키즈카페 2배로”)
item.description:
Candidates for the June 3 Seoul mayoral election, Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party and Jung Won-oh of the Democratic Party of Korea, unveiled children-related pledges on Children's Day. Candidate Oh emphasized expanding play and experience infrastructure, while Candidate Jung underscored strengthening pediatric care systems and reading-based education. (6·3 서울시장 선거에 출마한 오세훈 국민의힘 후보와 정원오 더불어민주당 후보가 어린이날을 맞아 나란히 어린이 관련 공약을 내놓았다. 오 후보는 놀이·체험 인프라 확충을, 정 후보는 소아진료 체계와 독서 기반 교육 강화를 각각 강조했다.)

Candidate Oh announced the "Happy City for Children, Seoul" pledge at the 'Green Green Kids Cafe' within the Seoul International Garden Fair on the 5th. The plan aims to expand children's right to play and educational opportunities while reducing parents' childcare burdens. (오 후보는 5일 서울국제정원박람회 내 ‘초록초록 키즈카페’에서 ‘아이 행복도시 서울’ 공약을 발표했다. 어린이의 놀 권리와 교육 기회를 확대하고, 부모의 돌봄 부담을 줄이겠다는 구상이다.)

As a key project, he proposed creating 'Seoul Children's Imagination Land,' a public vocational experience theme park, at eight hubs across Seoul. The goal is to allow career exploration and creative activities at a lower cost compared to private options. Alongside this, he plans to push forward the 'Children's Art Seed,' a project supporting hands-on arts education for elementary school students. The plan includes providing 8 months of support for education in fields like vocal music, instrumental music, theater, and dance to lower private education costs. The existing 'Seoul-style Kids Cafe' will be expanded twofold to 404 locations by 2030. (핵심 사업으로는 공공형 직업체험 테마파크인 ‘서울 어린이 상상랜드’를 서울 전역 8개 거점에 조성하는 방안을 제시했다. 민간과 비교해 보다 저렴한 비용으로 진로 체험과 창작 활동을 할 수 있도록 하겠다는 취지다. 이와 함께 초등학생 대상 예술 실기 교육 지원 사업인 ‘어린이 예술씨앗’도 추진한다. 성악·기악·연극·무용 등 교육을 8개월간 지원해 사교육비 부담을 낮추겠다는 계획이다. 기존에 추진해온 ‘서울형 키즈카페’는 2030년까지 404곳으로 두 배 확대한다.)

Candidate Jung announced pledges centered on children's health and education the previous day. The core of Candidate Jung's pledges is establishing a regional 24-hour pediatric care system and strengthening reading-based education. To this end, Jung stated that he would designate additional hospitals in five autonomous districts that lack Moonlight Children's Hospitals and Safe Clinics, which provide nighttime, holiday, and inpatient care, to address medical gaps. In the southwestern region, he plans to expand the pediatric emergency center and safe hospitals, while renewing efforts to establish a municipal children's hospital in the northeastern region to bridge regional disparities. (정 후보는 전날 어린이 건강과 교육을 중심으로 한 공약을 발표했다. 정 후보가 내세운 공약의 핵심은 권역별 24시간 소아진료 체계 구축과 독서 기반 교육 강화다. 이를 위해 정 후보는 야간·휴일 진료와 입원이 가능한 달빛어린이병원과 안심의원이 없는 5개 자치구에 관련 병원을 추가 지정해 의료 공백을 해소하겠다고 밝혔다. 서남권에는 소아전문응급센터와 안심병원을 확충하고, 동북권에는 시립 어린이 전문병원 설립을 다시 추진하는 등 지역 간 격차 해소에도 나선다.)

In the education sector, he announced plans to create a '15-minute Book Zone' to establish a reading environment within living areas, and to support literacy improvement through the deployment of professional 'Book Masters' and family-participatory reading programs. (교육 분야에서는 ‘15분 책세권’ 조성을 통해 생활권 내 독서 환경을 구축하고, 전문 ‘북마스터’ 배치와 가족 참여형 독서 프로그램 등을 통해 문해력 향상을 지원하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Both candidates continued their children-related on-site activities on this day. Candidate Jung met citizens in succession at the Children's Garden Festival held at Seoul Children's Grand Park, followed by Jamsil Baseball Stadium and the plaza in front of City Hall. Candidate Oh, after announcing his pledges at the Garden Fair Kids Cafe in the morning, completed a schedule of children's events at Seoul Plaza, Dongdaemun Design Plaza, and Yeouido Hangang Park. (두 후보는 이날 어린이 관련 현장 행보도 이어갔다. 정 후보는 서울 어린이대공원에서 열린 어린이정원 페스티벌을 시작으로 잠실야구장, 시청 앞 광장 등에서 잇따라 시민을 만났다. 오 후보는 오전 정원박람회 키즈카페에서 공약 발표를 한 데 이어 서울광장, 동대문디자인플라자, 여의도 한강공원 등에서 어린이 행사 일정을 소화했다.)

item.title: “Uncle Jaemyung~” President Lee’s video reply to children’s notes (“재명이 아저씨~” 어린이들 쪽지에 이 대통령 영상 답장)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung released a video directly answering children’s questions to mark the 104th Children’s Day. (이재명 대통령이 제104회 어린이날을 맞아 어린이들의 질문에 직접 답하는 영상을 공개했다.)

On the 5th, President Lee shared a 1-minute 49-second short video on YouTube and social media platforms. He wrote, “I’ve always felt sorry that I couldn’t reply individually to the notes you sent via Instagram and TikTok. On this Children’s Day, I’m responding to those precious feelings. If you ever have worries or things to say, please send me notes and comments anytime. I love you, children.” (이 대통령은 5일 유튜브와 사회관계망서비스(SNS)에 1분49초 분량의 쇼츠(짧은 영상)를 공개했다. 그러면서 “인스타(그램), 틱톡으로 보내준 쪽지들, 일일이 답장 못 해 늘 미안했습니다. 어린이날을 맞아 그 귀한 마음들에 답합니다”라며 “앞으로도 고민이나 하고 싶은 말이 있다면 쪽지와 댓글 언제든지 보내주세요. 어린이 여러분 사랑합니다”라고 적었다.)

In the video, a child said, “Uncle Jaemyung! I’m in 5th grade. I look up to you as my role model, Mr. President. If you work even harder as president, I think I’ll have nothing more to wish for.” President Lee replied, “A role model? Oh, it’s an honor. I’ll strive even harder to truly be a role model. Thank you.” (영상을 보면, 한 어린이가 “재명이 아저씨! 저는 5학년인데요. 대통령님을 롤모델로 삼고 있습니다. 재명 아저씨가 더욱더욱 열심히 대통령 일을 하신다면 제가 바랄 게 없을 것 같습니다”라고 하자 이 대통령은 “롤모델이요? 오, 영광입니다. 진짜 롤모델이 되도록 더 노력할게요. 고맙습니다”라고 답했다.)

To a request saying, “I don’t want to go to survival swimming class,” he answered, “But you still have to do it, what can we do? Even if it’s tough, learning it will be a great help someday in the future.” (“생존수영 안 가고 싶어요”라는 요청에는 “그래도 해야 되는데 어떡해? 그런데 힘들어도 배워놓으면 나중에 언젠가는 크게 도움이 될 거예요”라고 답했다.)

One child lamented, “Please let us go on picnics. We can’t go on school trips or field trips these days, and I’m so frustrated I could die.” President Lee responded, “That’s true, isn’t it? We should go on picnics and school trips, but it seems our teachers are having a very hard time. We’ll prepare well so that both friends and teachers can go safely without burden.” (한 어린이는 “제발 소풍 가게 해주세요. 요즘 수학여행도 못 가고 체험학습도 못 가고 너무 억울해 죽겠어요”라고 토로했다. 그러자 이 대통령은 “정말 그렇죠? 소풍도 수학여행도 가야 되는데 우리 선생님들이 매우 힘든 것 같아요. 친구들도 선생님들도 부담 없이 안전하게 다닐 수 있도록 우리가 잘 준비할게요”라고 답했다.)

There was also a request: “Mr. President, if it’s not too rude, could you please make Saturdays red like Sundays when you make calendars in the future? Because at my academy, the calendar shows Saturday in blue and tells me to go, so I’m asking if you could change it to red.” President Lee replied, “It seems that’s been troubling you. I’d like to make all days red holidays someday, but even if it’s not easy right now, I’ll try. You seem to have a tough time going to academy. Please hang in there a little more.” (“대통령님, 혹시 실례가 되지 않는다면 앞으로 달력을 만드실 때 토요일도 일요일처럼 빨간색으로 해주실 수 있나요? 왜냐하면 학원에서 달력에 토요일은 파란색이라(며) 나오라고 해서 빨간색으로 바꿔주실 수 있나 해서 여쭈어보았습니다”라는 요청도 있었다. 이 대통령은 “그것 때문에 힘든 모양이군요. 언젠가는 다 빨간날 만들면 좋겠는데 지금 당장은 쉽지 않아도 노력할게요. 학원 다니느라고 많이 힘든가 봐요. 조금만 잘 견뎌주세요”라고 답했다.)

To a thank-you message that said, “Hello, Mr. President. I’m a student attending elementary school. Thank you for always working hard for our country and our people,” he responded, “Oh, what a wonderful thought. I truly cheer you on. I’ll also work hard to become a more impressive person,” but then he chuckled and corrected, “But it’s ‘our country,’ not ‘our country’ in that sense,” smiling and fixing a nuance in Korean. (“대통령님 안녕하세요. 초등학교에 다니고 있는 한 학생입니다. 늘 저희 나라와 국민을 위해 힘 써주셔서 감사합니다”라는 감사 인사에는 “오, 이렇게 멋진 생각을. 정말로 응원합니다. 저도 더 멋진 사람이 되도록 노력할게요”라면서도 “그런데 저희 나라 아니고 우리나라인데”라며 웃으며 정정하기도 했다.)

President Lee also left a post on Facebook titled ‘On the 104th Children’s Day.’ He stated, “I pledge not to see children merely as objects of protection or cute beings, but to respect them as individuals with dignity and personality. I will continuously strive to become a dignified adult who protects the dignity of children.” He added, “I will do my utmost to create a society where every day of the year, not just today, feels like Children’s Day, and I wholeheartedly wish for the eternal health of our children, who are the future of South Korea.” (이 대통령은 이날 페이스북에 ‘104번째 어린이날을 맞이하며’라는 제목의 글도 남겼다. 이 대통령은 “어린이를 단지 보호의 대상이나 귀여운 존재로만 여기지 않고, 존엄과 인격을 지닌 한 사람으로 존중하겠다 다짐한다”며 “어린이의 품위를 지켜주는 품위 있는 어른이 되기 위해 끊임없이 노력하겠다”고 밝혔다. 이어 “오늘 하루에 그치지 않고, 1년 365일 매일이 어린이날처럼 느껴질 수 있는 사회를 만들기 위해 더욱 최선을 다하겠다”며 “대한민국의 미래인 우리 아이들이 늘 건강해 주기만을 온 마음으로 기원한다”고 덧붙였다. )

Meanwhile, President Lee invited about 200 children and their guardians to the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae on this day. The event included children from depopulated areas, multicultural families, and those living near Cheong Wa Dae, along with their guardians. The participating children toured the main building of Cheong Wa Dae with President Lee and his wife and enjoyed various games at the green space in front of Sangchunjae, which had been transformed into a one-day playground. (한편, 이 대통령은 이날 청와대로 어린이와 보호자 200여명을 초청했다. 이날 행사에는 인구 소멸 지역 아동과 다문화가정 아동, 청와대 인근 거주 아동 및 보호자 등이 참석했다. 참가 어린이들은 이 대통령 부부와 함께 청와대 본관을 돌아보고, 일일 놀이터로 탈바꿈한 상춘재 앞 녹지원에서 다양한 놀이를 즐겼다.)

Reporter Jeon Gwang-joon light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Hong-koo, former prime minister who held key posts under three administrations, dies at 92 (‘3개 정부 두루 요직’ 이홍구 전 국무총리 별세…향년 92)
item.description:
Lee Hong-koo, a former prime minister who was active across politics, diplomacy, and academia, passed away on the 5th. He was 92. (정치·외교·학계를 두루 넘나들며 활발히 활동했던 이홍구 전 국무총리가 5일 별세했다. 향년 92.)

Born in 1934, Lee attended Kyunggi High School and Seoul National University, and later earned his master's and doctoral degrees in political science from Emory University and Yale University in the United States. In 1969, he was appointed as a professor of political science at Seoul National University, gaining attention for his papers and commentaries in academic journals and newspapers that shed light on contemporary politics. He also served as president of the Korean Political Science Association, walking the path of a scholar. (이 전 총리는 1934년 태어나 경기고·서울대를 거쳐 미국 에모리대·예일대에서 정치학 석·박사 학위를 받은 뒤 1969년 서울대 정치학과 교수로 부임해 학술지와 신문 등에 당대 정치를 조명한 논문과 논설로 주목받았다. 한국정치학회 회장 등을 지내며 학자의 길을 걸었다.)

In 1988, he began his official public service career as Minister of National Unification under the Roh Tae-woo administration. Subsequently, he served as Special Political Advisor to the President and Ambassador to the United Kingdom. He is credited with constructively formulating the "Korean National Community Unification Plan," a unification proposal of the Roh Tae-woo government. Under the Kim Young-sam administration, he held the positions of Senior Vice Chairman of the Advisory Council on Democratic and Peaceful Unification, and Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Unification, before being inaugurated as the 28th Prime Minister in 1994. (1988년 노태우 정부에서 국토통일원 장관으로 입각해 본격적으로 공직 생활을 시작했다. 이후 대통령 정치특별보좌관과 주영국대사를 역임했다. 노태우 정부의 통일 방안인 ‘한민족 공동체 통일방안’을 전향적으로 성안하는 데 기여했다는 평가를 받았다. 김영삼 정부에서 민주평화통일자문회의 수석부의장, 부총리 겸 통일원 장관을 지낸 그는 1994년 제28대 국무총리에 취임했다.)

After his tenure as prime minister, he entered politics in 1996 as the leader of the then-ruling New Korea Party and was elected as a proportional representative member of the National Assembly in the 15th general election held that year. Although he served as the party's leader, he resigned from the position in December of that year amid backlash from the "labor law railroad" incident. Following the launch of the Kim Dae-jung government in 1998, he was appointed as the first Ambassador to the United States, working to quickly resolve the IMF (foreign exchange crisis) situation at the time. After 2000, he served as Chairman of the Seoul International Forum, Advisor to the JoongAng Ilbo, Advisor to the Korea Volleyball Association, Director of the Asan Social Welfare Foundation, and Chairman of the Yumin Cultural Foundation. (총리직을 마치고 나서는 1996년 당시 여당인 신한국당 대표위원으로 정치에 입문해, 같은 해 치러진 제15대 총선에서 전국구(현 비례대표) 국회의원으로 당선됐다. 그는 신한국당 대표를 맡았으나, 그해 12월 ‘노동법 날치기’ 사건의 역풍으로 대표직을 사임했다. 1998년 김대중 정부가 출범한 뒤 초대 주미대사로 발탁돼 당시 ‘아이엠에프(IMF·외환위기) 사태’의 조기 수습에 나섰다. 2000년 이후에는 서울국제포럼 이사장, 중앙일보 고문, 대한배구협회 고문, 아산사회복지재단 이사, 유민문화재단 이사장 등을 지냈다.)

On this day, the Democratic Party of Korea issued a commentary stating, "The deceased designed important directions for Korean Peninsula unification policy and foreign and security policy, and was unusually appointed as Ambassador to the United States under the Kim Dae-jung government as a figure from a conservative administration, dedicating himself to stabilizing South Korea-U.S. relations and restoring international trust," adding, "We will reflect on the legacy of the deceased, who practiced the values of rationality, moderation, and integration that Korean politics should aspire to." The People Power Party also stated in its commentary, "He was a symbol of rational conservatism and set milestones at every critical juncture in modern history as a scholar, administrator, and politician." (이날 더불어민주당은 논평을 내어 “고인은 한반도 통일 정책과 외교안보 정책의 중요한 방향을 설계했고, 보수정권 출신 인사로는 이례적으로 김대중 정부 주미대사로 기용돼 한미 관계 안정과 국제사회 신뢰 회복을 위해 헌신하셨다”며 “한국 정치가 지향해야 할 합리와 중용, 통합의 가치를 몸소 실천해 온 고인의 유산을 되새기겠다”고 밝혔다. 국민의힘도 논평에서 “합리적 보수의 상징이자 학자와 행정가, 정치인으로서 현대사의 고비마다 이정표를 세우셨다”고 밝혔다.)

Survivors include his spouse Park Han-ok, son Hyun-woo (Representative of EIG Asia), daughters So-young and Min-young (Professor at Dongduk Women's University), daughter-in-law Hwang Ji-young (President of the Korean Women's Association in Hong Kong), and son-in-law Lee Kang-ho (Professor at the Korea National University of Arts). The funeral hall is set up at Asan Medical Center in Seoul, with the burial scheduled for 8:00 a.m. on the 8th, and the burial site at Cheonan Park Cemetery. (02)3010-2000. (유족으로는 배우자 박한옥씨와 아들 현우(EIG 아시아 대표)씨, 딸 소영·민영(동덕여대 교수)씨, 며느리 황지영(홍콩한인여성회장)씨, 사위 이강호(한국예술종합학교 교수)씨 등이 있다. 빈소는 서울아산병원에 차려졌으며, 발인은 8일 오전 8시, 장지는 천안공원묘지다. (02)3010-2000.)

Lee Ji-eun, Reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Yoon Suk Yeol's Office: 'Analysis of Hormuz Ship Incident Cause Expected to Take Several Days' (청와대 “호르무즈 선박 사고 원인 분석 수일 걸릴 것 예상”)
item.description:
On the 5th, the presidential office stated regarding the fire on a South Korean vessel in the Strait of Hormuz: "For an objective and reliable determination of the cause, aside from the shipping company's own investigation, we plan to urgently dispatch investigators from the Korea Maritime Safety Tribunal and forensic experts from the National Fire Agency to the site." (청와대가 호르무즈해협에서 벌어진 우리 선박 화재와 관련해 “객관적이고 신뢰성 있는 원인 규명을 위해 선사 자체 조사와 별도로 중앙해양안전심판원 소속 조사관과 소방청 감식 전문가를 현지에 급파할 예정”이라고 5일 밝혔다.)

The presidential office held a meeting presided over by Chief of Staff Kang Hun-sik from 12:30 p.m. for about an hour to assess the situation and discuss response measures related to the maritime ship fire in Hormuz. Senior Press Secretary Kang Yoo-jung said in a written briefing after the meeting, "Regarding the investigation into the cause of the accident, the government plans to move the accident vessel to a nearby port via a tugboat contracted by the shipping company and then dock it," adding, "Subsequently, we will immediately dispatch personnel from the Korean Register of Shipping's local branch in Dubai to conduct safety inspections." Considering factors such as the deployment of tugboats, docking, dispatch of domestic investigation personnel, and analysis periods, it is expected that the cause analysis will take several days. The meeting was attended by Director of National Crisis Management Center Kim Sang-ho, Foreign Policy Secretary Choi Hee-duk, Maritime and Fisheries Secretary Lee Hyun, and Director of National Affairs Situation Office Kim Jung-woo. (청와대는 이날 낮 12시30분부터 1시간가량 강훈식 비서실장 주재로 호르무즈 해상 선박 화재와 관련한 상황 점검 및 대처 방안을 논의하는 회의를 열었다. 강유정 수석대변인은 회의 뒤 서면 브리핑에서 “사고 원인 조사와 관련해 정부는 사고 선박의 선사와 계약된 예인선을 통해 인근 항만으로 이동한 뒤 접안할 예정”이라며 “이어 두바이 현지의 한국선급 지부 인력을 즉각 파견해 안전 검사를 시행할 예정”이라고 말했다. 예인선의 투입과 접안, 국내 조사 인력 파견 및 분석 기간 등을 고려할 때 원인 분석에는 며칠이 걸릴 것이라고 내다봤다. 회의에는 김상호 국가위기관리센터장, 최희덕 외교정책비서관, 이현 해양수산비서관, 김정우 국정상황실장 등이 참석했다.)

Additionally, the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and the Cheonghae Unit are monitoring the safety status of the accident vessel and its crew in real time. Senior Press Secretary Kang stated, "To prevent concern among the crew members' families, the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and the shipping company are directly explaining the situation and actively responding to inquiries," adding, "The government has been in daily contact with 26 South Korean vessels anchored inside the Strait of Hormuz since the outbreak of war in the Middle East, and is fully committed to ensuring safety and providing necessary support." (아울러 해양수산부와 청해부대는 사고 선박과 선원들의 안전 상황을 실시간으로 파악하고 있다. 강 수석대변인은 “선원 가족들이 우려하지 않게 해수부와 선사가 직접 상황을 설명하고 문의에도 적극 대응하고 있다”며 “정부는 중동 전쟁 발발 후 호르무즈해협 내측에 정박 중인 우리 선박 26척과 일 단위로 연락을 지속하고 있으며 안전 확보와 필요한 지원에도 만전을 기하고 있다”고 말했다.)

The government also stated that it is maintaining close communication with the United States, Iran, and member countries of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC: Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman) by mutually sharing relevant information. It has instructed embassies in the relevant countries to identify and report related trends in real time. Senior Press Secretary Kang stated, "The government prioritizes the safety of our citizens and vessels and will swiftly and thoroughly implement all necessary measures." (정부는 이밖에도 미국과 이란, 걸프협력회의(GCC) 회원국(사우디아라비아·아랍에미리트(UAE)·쿠웨이트·카타르·바레인·오만)과도 관련 정보를 상호 공유하며 긴밀한 소통을 유지하고 있다고 밝혔다. 관련국에 있는 대사관에는 관련 동향을 실시간으로 파악해 보고할 것을 지시했다. 강 수석대변인은 “정부는 우리 국민과 선박의 안전을 최우선으로 두고, 필요한 모든 조치를 신속하고 철저하게 추진해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Earlier, at around 8:40 p.m. on the 4th (Korean time), an explosion and fire occurred on the HMM NAMU, a vessel operated by a South Korean shipping company, while it was anchored in waters near the United Arab Emirates (UAE) inside the Strait of Hormuz. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that all 24 crew members on board, including 6 South Korean nationals, were unharmed. (앞서 4일 오후 8시40분께(한국시각) 호르무즈해협 내측 아랍에미리트(UAE) 인근 해역에 정박 중이던 한국 선사 운용 선박 에이치엠엠 나무(HMM NAMU)호에서 폭발과 함께 화재가 발생했다. 이 선박에 탑승 중이던 우리 국적 선원 6명을 포함한 전체 선원 24명은 피해가 없다고 외교부는 밝혔다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Child at presidential office asks… President Lee says, “If you do wrong, you can be kicked out” (청와대 온 어린이가 묻자…이 대통령 “잘못하면 쫓겨나요”)
item.description:
“What does the president do?” “I think about how to help the people of South Korea, including children, live better lives, and how to wisely spend the taxes you all pay.” (“대통령은 어떤 일을 하나요?” “어린이를 포함해서 대한민국 국민들이 어떻게 하면 더 잘 살 수 있을까 고민하고, 여러분이 내는 세금을 어떻게 잘 쓸지 고민해요.”)

President Lee Jae-myung invited about 200 children and their guardians to the presidential office, Cheong Wa Dae, on Children’s Day, May 5. At the event titled ‘Welcome, is this your first time at Cheong Wa Dae?’, children toured the main building of Cheong Wa Dae, including the Sejong Room, where Cabinet meetings are held, and the Chungmu Room, used for meetings and appointment ceremonies, and bombarded President Lee with questions. (이재명 대통령이 5일 어린이날을 맞아 어린이와 보호자 200여명을 청와대로 초대했다. ‘어서 와, 청와대는 처음이지?’라는 이름으로 열린 이번 행사에서 어린이들은 국무회의가 열리는 세종실, 간담회와 임명식을 진행하는 충무실 등 청와대 본관을 견학하며 이 대통령에게 질문을 쏟아냈다.)

That morning, President Lee, along with First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, greeted the children in front of the main building of Cheong Wa Dae. As President Lee gave a friendly ‘high-five’ greeting, the children exclaimed “Wow!” and showed excitement. One child said, “It’s amazing and happy to actually meet the president.” After a group photo, they moved to the Sejong Room, where Cabinet meetings are held, and experienced a mock Cabinet meeting. (이날 오전 이 대통령은 김혜경 여사와 함께 청와대 본관 앞에서 어린이들을 맞이했다. 이 대통령이 ‘하이파이브’를 하며 반갑게 인사를 건네자 아이들은 “우와” 하며 신나는 기색을 내비쳤다. “대통령 아저씨를 실제로 만나 신기하고 행복하다”고 말한 어린이도 있었다. 기념촬영을 마친 이들은 국무회의가 열리는 세종실으로 이동해 모의 국무회의 체험을 했다.)

President Lee said, “This is where very important meetings take place, deciding how to influence South Korea. It’s marked which positions sit where, so each of you should think of yourself as the minister of your seat and tell me what you’d like to say.” (이 대통령은 “대한민국에 어떻게 관여할지를 정하는 매우 중요한 회의를 하는 곳”이라며 “어떤 분들이 앉는 자리인지 표시돼있는데, 각자 자기 자리의 장관이라고 생각하고 하고 싶은 이야기를 들어보겠다”고 했다.)

When no child raised a hand, he joked, “If there’s no child to ask a question, I’ll pick someone myself.” The children asked, “When do Cabinet meetings happen?”, “Why is Children’s Day on May 5th?”, and “When will unification happen?” (손을 드는 어린이가 없자 “질문할 어린이가 없으면 대통령이 지명하도록 하겠습니다”라고 농담하기도 했다. 아이들은 “국무회의는 언제 하는 거예요?”, “어린이날은 왜 5월5일이에요?”, “통일 언제 해요?”라고 질문을 던졌다.)

When a child asked, “How did you become president?”, President Lee replied, “If you prepare well and work hard for the people, and gain their recognition, you become president. But if you do wrong along the way, you could be kicked out.” To the question, “How did you feel when you were elected president?”, he answered, “First, I felt good, and then I thought I had to do well.” (한 어린이가 “어떻게 대통령이 됐어요?”라고 묻자 이 대통령은 “평소에 국민들을 위해서 잘 준비하고 열심히 노력해서 국민들에게 인정받으면 대통령이 되고, 하다가 잘못하면 쫓겨날 수도 있다”라고 답했다. “대통령으로 뽑혔을 때 기분이 어땠어요?”라는 질문에는 “일단 기분이 좋고 다음에는 잘해야겠다는 생각이 들었어요”라고 했다.)

Deputy Spokesperson An Gwi-ryeong of Cheong Wa Dae said, “If any child wants to become president, please raise your hand,” and several children did. When asked why they wanted to become president, they replied, “Because I can freely tour Cheong Wa Dae,” “Because I want to create a peaceful country,” and “Because I want to build many libraries.” (안귀령 청와대 부대변인이 “대통령이 되고 싶은 어린이가 있다면 손을 들어보라”고 하자 참석한 어린이 여러 명이 손을 들었다. 대통령이 되고 싶은 이유를 묻자 이들은 “청와대를 마음껏 구경할 수 있어서”, “평화로운 나라를 만들고 싶어서”, “도서관을 많이 짓고 싶어서”라고 대답했다.)

Afterwards, President Lee moved to the Chungmu Room, where meetings and appointment ceremonies are held, and said, “This room is a place to gather and discuss or have meetings with the public. Ask Uncle President, Uncle Chief of Staff, or Grandfather Senior Secretary anything you’re curious about.” (이후 이 대통령은 간담회, 임명식 등이 열리는 청와대 충무실로 이동해 “이 방은 국민 여러분과 모여서 토론하거나 회의하는 장소”라며 “대통령 아저씨, 비서실장 아저씨, 사회수석 할아버지(에게 궁금한 것을 물어보라)”고 했다.)

When a child asked, “What food do you eat as president?”, President Lee replied, “I eat the same things as you: kimchi stew, braised anchovies, and seaweed too.” The children responded with, “That sounds delicious.” (한 어린이가 “대통령이 되면 무슨 음식을 먹어요?”라고 묻자 이 대통령은 “여러분과 똑같이 김치찌개, 멸치조림도 먹어요. 김도 먹어요”라고 답했다. 아이들은 “맛있겠다”라며 호응했다.)

That day, the Nokjiwon garden was transformed into a one-day amusement park. Children rode rides like spinning swings and air bounces, and participated in activities such as making keycaps, face painting, and making cupcakes. At the face painting booth, President Lee drew K-pop Demon Hunters character ‘Duffy’ on his hand, while First Lady Kim painted a rainbow and smiley face. (이날 녹지원은 일일 놀이공원으로 꾸며졌다. 어린이들은 회전 그네, 에어바운스 같은 놀이기구를 타고 ‘키캡’ 만들기, 페이스 페인팅, 컵케이크 만들기 등 체험활동도 했다. 페이스 페인팅 코너에서 이 대통령은 손등에 케이팝 데몬 헌터스의 캐릭터 ‘더피’를, 김 여사는 무지개와 스마일 그림을 그렸다.)

About 200 children and their guardians from diverse backgrounds attended the event, including children from depopulated areas, children in care facilities, children from single-parent and multicultural families, children with disabilities and rare diseases, and children living near Cheong Wa Dae. A child whom President Lee and First Lady had met during a meeting with patients and their families last year also attended. (이날 행사에는 인구소멸지역 거주 어린이, 보호시설 어린이, 한부모·다문화 가정 어린이, 장애·희귀질환 어린이, 청와대 인근 거주 어린이 등 다양한 환경의 어린이와 보호자 200여명이 참석했다. 지난해 이 대통령 부부가 환우·가족 간담회를 통해 만났던 어린이도 함께했다.)

Deputy Spokesperson An conveyed in a written briefing that President Lee said, “At least for today, Cheong Wa Dae has become a place filled with children’s laughter,” and expressed gratitude to the guardians and teachers who help children grow up healthy and strong. President Lee stated, “I will fulfill my duty as president to ensure our children can grow up in a safer environment,” and “I will do my best to create a country where children can nurture their dreams in any environment and challenge themselves based on fair opportunities.” (안 부대변인은 이 대통령이 “오늘 하루만큼은 청와대가 어린이들의 웃음으로 가득 찬 공간이 됐다”며 어린이들이 건강하고 씩씩하게 자랄 수 있도록 해준 보호자와 교사들에게 감사 인사를 건넸다고 서면브리핑을 통해 전했다. 이 대통령은 “우리 어린이들이 보다 안전한 환경에서 자랄 수 있도록 대통령으로서의 책무를 다하겠다”며 “어린이들이 어떤 환경에서도 각자의 꿈을 키워나가고 공정한 기회를 바탕으로 도전할 수 있는 나라를 만들 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Go Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Min-sik: “Yoon Suk Yeol is the Eternal President, His Patriotism is Number One”… His “Anti-Impeachment” Record Resurfaces (박민식 “윤석열 영원한 대통령, 애국심 넘버원”…‘반탄 행적’ 소환)
item.description:
As former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-sik was elected as the People Power Party candidate for the Busan Buk-gu Gap by-election, held concurrently with the June 3 local elections, his actions during last year’s impeachment crisis of former President Yoon Suk Yeol are being reexamined. Park took to the stage at anti-impeachment rallies, praising Yoon as the “eternal president” and arguing, “How can a sitting president possibly be a ringleader of insurrection?” (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 국민의힘 후보에 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관이 선출된 가운데, 지난해 윤석열 전 대통령 탄핵 정국 당시 박 후보의 행적이 재조명되고 있다. 박 후보는 탄핵 반대 집회 연단에 올라 “영원한 대통령”이라며 윤 전 대통령을 추어올렸고 “도대체 현직 대통령이 내란수괴가 될 수 있나”라고 주장하기도 했다.)

On March 22 of last year, Park stood on the podium at an anti-impeachment rally in front of the Constitutional Court in Jongno-gu, Seoul, organized by the citizen group “National Defense Team.” This was about two weeks before Yoon was removed from office by a unanimous decision of the Constitutional Court. (박 후보는 지난해 3월22일 서울 종로구 헌법재판소 앞에서 윤 전 대통령 탄핵을 반대하는 시민 모임 ‘국민변호인단’이 연 집회 연단에 올랐다. 윤 전 대통령이 헌재의 전원일치 결정으로 파면되기 약 2주 전이다.)

At the event, Park began his remarks by saying, “Today is the 12th day, and we are engaging in a 24-hour overnight sit-in protest right in front of the Constitutional Court.” At the time, supporters of Yoon were staging a hunger strike and overnight protest demanding the impeachment be rejected or dismissed, and Park joined them to show support for their fast. In front of Park during the sit-in was a placard reading: “The president chosen by the people; forced impeachment is a path to national ruin.” (이 자리에서 박 후보는 “오늘이 12일 차인데 헌법재판소 바로 앞에서 24시간 철야 노숙 투쟁을 하고 있다”는 말로 발언을 시작했다. 당시 윤 전 대통령 지지자들이 탄핵 각하 또는 기각을 요구하며 노숙 단식 투쟁을 벌였는데 박 후보가 이들의 단식을 응원하며 합류한 것이다. 노숙하는 박 후보 앞에는 ‘국민이 선택한 대통령, 억지 탄핵은 망국의 길’이라고 적힌 피켓이 있었다.)

Park stated, “As someone who has watched from the sidelines, President Yoon Suk Yeol’s patriotism is truly number one,” adding, “Protecting the nation and its people so that we can each run toward our dreams and share a happy day laughing with our beloved families is Yoon Suk Yeol’s eternal dream.” He further remarked, “Our eternal president.” (박 후보는 “정말 옆에서 지켜본 사람으로서 대통령 윤석열의 애국심은 정말 넘버원”이라며 “우리가 저마다 꿈을 향해 달리고 사랑하는 가족과 함께 웃는 행복한 하루를 보내도록 국가와 국민을 지키는 것이 윤석열의 영원한 꿈”이라고 말했다. “우리의 영원한 대통령”이라고도 덧붙였다.)

Continuing, Park said, “Everyone, from December 3, you have fought for over 100 days with truly unmatched bravery,” and “If we stand together, we can surely protect our President Yoon Suk Yeol.” He also asserted, “When we chant ‘Yoon Suk Yeol, Yoon Suk Yeol,’ it is a promise to defend Yoon Suk Yeol to the end. Now, the tide has truly turned. The pitch-black winter of impeachment is passing, and a warm spring day, the spring of dismissal, has arrived.” (이어 박 후보는 “여러분, 12월3일부터 100일 넘게 정말 용맹무쌍하게 잘 싸우셨다”며 “우리가 함께하면 반드시 우리 대통령 윤석열, 지킬 수 있다”고 했다. “우리가 윤석열, 윤석열 외치는 것은 끝까지 윤석열을 지키겠다는 약속이다. 이제 정말 대세는 기울었다. 그 칠흑 같은 깜깜한 탄핵의 겨울은 지나가고 이제 따뜻한 봄날, 각하의 봄이 왔다”고도 했다.)

At the conclusion of his speech that day, when Park shouted, “Who is the proud president of the Republic of Korea chosen by you?” the participants chanted “Yoon Suk Yeol” in unison. At the rally, People Power Party floor leader Jang Dong-hyuk and top committee member Kim Min-soo also attended, stating respectively, “Impeachment has lost its ground,” and “Please save the president.” (이날 연설 말미에 박 후보가 “여러분이 선택한 대한민국의 당당한 대통령 누구인가”라고 외치자 참가자들은 “윤석열”을 연호했다. 이날 집회에는 국민의힘 장동혁 대표와 김민수 최고위원도 참석해 각각 “탄핵은 설 자리를 잃었다”, “대통령을 구해달라”고 말했다.)

Park’s anti-impeachment record extends further. According to the YouTube channel of Lee Young-pung, a former KBS reporter who competed against Park in the People Power Party primary for Busan Buk-gu Gap but was eliminated, Park conducted an interview with Lee in front of the Constitutional Court on March 29 last year. Lee introduced Park as one of the “patriots guarding the struggle site.” (박 후보의 ‘반탄’ 행적은 또 있다. 박 후보와 부산 북갑 국민의힘 경선에서 경쟁했다가 탈락한 이영풍 전 한국방송(KBS) 기자의 유튜브 채널을 보면, 박 후보는 지난해 3월29일 헌재 앞에서 이 전 기자와 인터뷰를 진행했다. 이 전 기자는 박 후보를 ‘투쟁 현장을 지키는 애국자들’ 가운데 한 명으로 소개했다.)

At that time, Park expressed “certainty” that the impeachment would be either rejected or dismissed. He said, “As a legal expert, I am certain. Yoon Suk Yeol’s return to office—I see the countdown beginning, and a decision will be made in about three to four days, or at most within five days. The result will be 90% rejection and 10% dismissal. I am confident.” (당시 박 후보는 탄핵 각하 또는 기각을 “확신한다”고 말했다. 박 후보는 “법률가로서 확신한다. 윤석열 대통령 직무 복귀, 제가 볼 때는 카운트다운 들어가서 한 3~4일, 늦어도 5일 안에는 결정되리라고 보고 그 결과는 각하가 90%, 기각이 10%”라며 “저는 확신하고 있다”고 했다.)

He also engaged in a debate over the impeachment with former People Power Party lawmaker Jae-hyung Choi. On February 25 last year, Choi posted on Facebook arguing that “While it is by no means desirable, the impeachment (of former President Yoon) is inevitable,” and citing Yoon’s deployment of troops to the National Assembly, claimed that the December 3 martial law violated the constitution and laws. In response, Park posted on Facebook the same day a piece titled “Opposing Jae-hyung Choi’s Inevitability Theory of Impeachment,” arguing, “From the public’s perspective, the core question is whether this can be seen as insurrection. How on earth can a sitting president be a ringleader of insurrection?” (최재형 전 국민의힘 의원과 탄핵 관련 논쟁을 벌이기도 했다. 지난해 2월25일 최 전 의원은 페이스북에 글을 올려 “결코 원하는 바는 아니지만 (윤 전 대통령) 탄핵은 불가피하다”며 윤 전 대통령이 국회에 군대를 보낸 사실 등을 들어 12·3 비상계엄은 헌법과 법률 위반이라고 주장했다. 그러자 박 후보는 같은 날 페이스북에 “최재형 의원의 탄핵 불가피론에 반대함”이라는 제목의 글을 올려 “국민 눈높이에서 보면 결국 내란이라고 볼 수 있느냐가 핵심 관건이다. 도대체 현직 대통령이 내란수괴가 될 수 있나”라고 주장했다.)

However, that post can no longer be found on Park’s Facebook page. Screenshots of Facebook posts apparently written by the former minister regarding the impeachment of former President Yoon are being shared on online communities. (다만 해당 글은 현재 박 후보 페이스북에서 찾아볼 수 없다. 온라인 커뮤니티에는 박 전 장관이 쓴 것으로 보이는 윤 전 대통령 탄핵 관련 페이스북 게시글들을 갈무리한 사진이 공유되고 있다.)

According to the images, a post dated April 4 last year, the day of Yoon’s impeachment, titled “Yoon is back,” contained the text: “It is the will of heaven. President Yoon Suk Yeol will return.” Another post included content such as, “How can that man (former President Yoon) be a ringleader of insurrection?” (March 22 last year), and “Looking at the motive, process, and actual damage of the martial law declaration, it is clear that a charge of insurrection does not hold” (February 26 last year). (사진을 보면, 윤 전 대통령 탄핵 당일인 지난해 4월4일 작성된 “Yoon is back”(윤 전 대통령은 돌아온다)이라는 제목의 글에 “하늘의 뜻이다. 윤석열 대통령은 복귀한다”는 내용이 쓰여 있다. 또 다른 글에는 “어찌 저 사람(윤 전 대통령)이 내란수괴인가”(지난해 3월22일), “비상계엄 선포의 동기와 과정 그리고 실질적 피해 유무를 살펴보면 ‘내란죄 불성립’은 명백하다”(지난해 2월26일) 등의 내용이 담겨 있다.)

The issue is that these posts are also no longer findable on Park’s Facebook page. A check of Park’s Facebook on the 5th reveals no posts between a post from December 31, 2023, and January 15 of this year—a gap of nearly two years. (문제는 이 글들도 현재는 박 후보 페이스북에서 찾아볼 수 없다는 점이다. 5일 박 후보 페이스북을 보면, 2023년 12월31일 게시글 이후 올해 1월15일까지 약 2년간의 게시글이 없다.)

Regarding this, Shin Ji-ho, a former vice president of strategy and planning for the People Power Party and a member of the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction, pointed out in a Facebook post on the 2nd, “When I looked into Park Min-sik’s Facebook, I was truly shocked. Except for a profile picture change on January 15, 2024, and a cover photo change on February 17, 2025, two years’ worth of records had been entirely deleted.” He added, “The deletion of records from 2025 was initially incomprehensible. That’s because they contained records showcasing his appearance as a Yoon-again fighter, such as his participation in anti-impeachment rallies and sit-in protests, and the expression of his belief that Yoon would inevitably return as president,” claiming, “To broaden his appeal in the general election, he preemptively erased his Yoon-again colors.” (이를 두고 ‘친한동훈계’인 신지호 전 국민의힘 전략기획부총장은 지난 2일 페이스북 글에서 “박민식의 페북을 살펴보니 충격 그 자체였다. 24년 1월15일 프로필 사진 교체와 25년 2월17일 커버 사진 교체 2건을 제외하고 2년 치 기록이 통으로 삭제돼 있었다”고 지적했다. 그러면서 “25년 기록 삭제는 처음에는 이해 불가였다. 반탄 집회 참가 및 노숙 농성, 윤석열은 반드시 대통령으로 돌아온다는 신념의 표출 등 윤 어게인 투사로서의 면모를 담은 기록이었기 때문”이라며 “본선에서 확장성을 갖기 위해서 윤 어게인 색깔 지우기를 선제적으로 한 것”이라고 주장했다.)

Appearing on the JoongAng Ilbo YouTube channel “Uncomfortable Yeouido” on the 5th, Park was asked about the controversy over deleting his Facebook posts from 2024–2025. He evaded a direct answer, saying, “I don’t know who deleted them, or if it was done by our office.” (박 후보는 5일 중앙일보 유튜브 ‘불편한 여의도’에 나와 “2024~25년 페이스북 글을 삭제한 것이 논란이 된다”는 지적에 “누가 삭제했는지, 우리 사무실에서 했는지는 모르겠다”며 즉답을 피했다.)

Jeon Gwang-jun, reporter light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Criticism over "Oppa" remark leads Democratic Research Institute Deputy Director to fire back with "Depraved minds" and "Word censorship" (“오빠” 발언 비판에 민주연구원 부원장 “음란마귀·단어검열” 막말)
item.description:
Amid ongoing criticism of Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae’s "Try saying oppa" comment—which has persisted despite his repeated apologies—Kim Gwang-min, deputy director of the Democratic Research Institute, has sparked further controversy by justifying the remark, asking, "Are you filled with depraved spirits?" (정청래 더불어민주당 대표의 ‘“오빠 해봐요” 발언에 대한 비판이 정 대표의 거듭된 사과에도 수그러지지 않고 있는 가운데, 김광민 민주연구원 부원장이 “음란 마귀로 가득찼느냐”며 발언을 정당화하고 나서 논란이 확산되고 있다.)

In a Facebook post on the 4th, Deputy Director Kim wrote, "I really don’t know where that amazing imagination—that drags child sexual abuse into a single use of the word 'oppa'—comes from." He added, "Is it that your head is so full of depraved spirits that even an ordinary term of address between people of different ages sounds sexual to you?" He argued, "This isn’t feminism; it’s just projecting your own distorted sexual fantasies onto innocent people," and included hashtags such as "#WordCensorship," "#OveractiveImagination," and "#IgnoranceIsBlindness." Kim is a member of the Gyeonggi Provincial Council. (김 부원장은 지난 4일 자신의 페이스북에 글을 올려 “아니, ‘오빠” 소리 한 번에 아동 성희롱까지 끌어오는 그 대단한 상상력은 대체 어디서 나오는 건지 모르겠다”며 “본인 머릿속이 온통 음란 마귀로 가득 차 있으니 나이 차이 나는 남녀가 부르는 평범한 호칭조차 섹슈얼하게 들리는 것 아니냐”고 썼다. 그는 “이건 페미니즘이 아니라 그냥 본인의 왜곡된 성적 판타지를 애먼 사람한테 투사하는 수준”이라며 ‘호칭 검열’, ‘상상력 과잉’, ‘무식하면 용감하다’ 등의 해시태그를 달았다. 김 부원장은 경기도의회 의원이다.)

After the post stirred controversy, Kim uploaded another message. He stated, "Worried that it might have an unintended impact on the election, I deleted the (relevant) post, but the current distortion of language must be addressed." He called it "a serious case of 'contextual appropriation,' where a biased frame is projected onto specific terms, corrupting their original meaning." He also wrote, "Realizing that the criticism pouring in is less about my personal shortcomings and more about the community's 'targeting' attacks, I’ve now come to calmly enjoy it." The post received critical comments such as, "How can you write this when educators and mothers raising kids are even filing lawsuits? You’re really lacking," and "Jeong Cheong-rae himself apologized—are you the only one defending him so fiercely?" (이 글에 대해 논란이 일자 김 부원장은 또다른 글을 올렸다. 그는 “선거에 의도하지 않은 영향을 미칠 것을 우려하여 (해당) 게시물은 삭제했으나, 작금의 언어 왜곡 현상은 반드시 짚고 넘어가야겠다”며 “특정 용어에 편향된 프레임을 투사해 본래 의미를 변질시키는 것은 심각한 ‘맥락적 전유’”라고 했다. 또 “게시물에 쏟아진 비난이 개인의 부족함보다는 커뮤니티의 ‘좌표 찍기’ 공격임을 깨닫고, 이제는 이를 의연하게 즐기게 됨”이라는 글도 게시했다. 이 글에는 “교육계와 아이 키우는 어머님들이 고소까지 하고 난리인데 이렇게 글을 쓰다니, 많이 부족하다”, “정청래 (대표)도 사과한 거 혼자 열심히 방어하느냐”  등의 비판 댓글이 달렸다. )

Earlier, on the 3rd, Jeong had told a first-grade elementary school student at Busan’s Gupo Market to call candidate Ha "oppa" during a campaign rally. As the controversy escalated, Secretary General Cho Seung-rae issued a "caution against rumors" to the party and its candidates on the 4th, saying, "We must not let our guard down for even a moment." A first-term lawmaker from the metropolitan area remarked on the 5th, "The leader apologized and the secretary general told everyone to stay vigilant—I simply can’t understand why (Deputy Director Kim) is stoking the fire again." (앞서 정 대표는 지난 3일 부산 구포시장에서 지원 유세를 하다가 초등학교 1학년 학생에게 하 후보를 “오빠”라고 부르라고 했고, 논란이 커지자 조승래 사무총장이 지난 4일 “한시라도 긴장의 끈을 놓지 말아야 한다”며 당과 후보들에게 ‘구설 경계령’을 내렸다. 수도권 초선 의원은 5일 “대표가 사과하고 사무총장이 긴장하자고 얘기했는데 (김 부원장이) 왜 다시 논란에 불을 지피는지 도대체 이해할 수 없다”고 말했다.)

Criticism of Jeong’s remarks continues from parent and women’s groups. The Korean Women’s Association United issued a statement that day, noting, "Campaign sites are public spaces where voters and candidates meet, and candidates convey their policies and visions." It pointed out, "A remark in a public space telling a future generation and citizen voter to call someone 'oppa' clearly reveals a lack of a gender-sensitive perspective." The previous day, the conservative parent group Alliance for the Protection of Student, Parent, and Teacher Rights filed a complaint with the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office against Jeong and Ha Jeong-woo, the Democratic Party candidate for the Busan Buk-gu by-election, on charges of emotional abuse under the Child Welfare Act. (학부모·여성단체 등에서 정 대표의 발언에 대한 비판도 이어지고 있다. 한국여성단체연합은 이날 성명을 내어 “유세 현장은 유권자 시민과 후보자가 만나고, 후보자는 자신의 정책과 비전을 전달하는 공적 공간”이라면서 “공적 공간에서 미래세대이자 유권자 시민에게 ‘오빠’라고 불러보라고 한 발언은 성인지적 관점이 부재함을 여실히 드러낸 것”이라고 지적했다. 전날 보수 성향 학부모 단체인 학생학부모교사인권보호연대는 정 대표와 하정우 부산북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보를 아동복지법상 정서적 학대 혐의로 대검찰청에 고발했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Son Ji-min sjm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr 손지민 기자 sjm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: “Trying to Erase Trials with Special Counsel After Elections”… People Power Party Aims for Game Reversal (“선거 뒤 특검으로 재판 지우려해”…국힘, 판세 반전 노려)
item.description:
The People Power Party is sharply escalating its offensive surrounding the “fabricated indictment special counsel bill” proposed by the Democratic Party. This appears to be an attempt to ignite a rallying point for conservative supporters by raising the narrative of judging the government and ruling party ahead of the June 3 local elections. (국민의힘이 더불어민주당이 발의한 ‘조작기소 특검법’을 둘러싼 공세 수위를 한껏 끌어올리고 있다. 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 정부·여당 심판론을 띄워 보수 지지층 결집에 불씨로 활용하려는 의도로 보인다.)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk held a press conference at the National Assembly on the 5th and criticized, “President Lee Jae-myung is only preoccupied with covering up his own crimes,” adding, “He is writing a guidebook for dictatorship that will go down in world history.” Jang continued, “Since (President Lee’s) approval ratings have plummeted, it seems he is trying to postpone (the handling of the special counsel bill) until after the local elections,” and claimed, “The conclusion is Lee Jae-myung’s command to ultimately withdraw the indictment no matter what, but just to delay the timing a bit.” (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 5일 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “이재명 대통령은 본인 범죄 지우는 데만 여념이 없다”며 “세계사에 길이 남을 독재 가이드북을 쓰고 있는 것”이라고 비판했다. 장 대표는 이어 “(이 대통령) 지지율이 뚝 떨어지니까 일단은 지방선거 이후로 (특검법 처리를) 미루려는 모양새”라며 “결론은 끝까지 반드시 공소 취소는 하되 시간만 좀 늦춰보라는 이재명의 명령”이라고 주장했다.)

Earlier, Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo stated at a briefing the previous day regarding the fabricated indictment special counsel bill, “As for the specific timing and procedures, we ask the Democratic Party to judge after going through a process of gathering public opinion and deliberation.” This was interpreted as President Lee being concerned about the negative impact on elections in the Yeongnam region and battleground areas in the Seoul metropolitan area, thus delaying the handling until after the local elections. People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok wrote on Facebook that day, “It’s a deceitful trick to fool the people ahead of the elections,” and “They are deceiving the public as if there is no withdrawal of the indictment before the local elections, but after the elections, they intend to erase the trial with a special counsel.” The People Power Party is considering measures such as a filibuster to block the special counsel bill and street protests. Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon, Gangwon Province governor candidate Kim Jin-tae, and Jeonnam-Gwangju Unified Special City mayoral candidate Lee Jeong-hyeon, among other People Power Party candidates for regional leadership, also held a press conference in front of Bosingak in Jongno-gu, Seoul, and issued a resolution demanding “a complete halt to the proposal of the special counsel bill for Lee Jae-myung’s self-amnesty and unconstitutional withdrawal of indictment.” (앞서 홍익표 청와대 정무수석은 전날 브리핑에서 조작기소 특검법과 관련해 “구체적인 시기와 절차에 대해서는 민주당이 국민적 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 거쳐서 판단해달라”고 밝혔다. 이를 두고 이 대통령이 영남과 수도권 접전 지역 선거에 미칠 악영향을 우려해 지방선거 뒤로 처리를 미룬 것이란 해석이 나왔다. 송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 페이스북에 “선거를 앞두고 국민을 눈속임하겠다는 조삼모사 사기극”이라며 “지방선거 전까진 공소 취소가 없는 것처럼 국민을 기만하고, 선거가 끝나면 특검으로 재판을 지워버리겠다는 것”이라고 썼다. 국민의힘은 특검법 저지를 위한 무제한 토론, 장외투쟁 등을 검토하고 있다. 오세훈 서울시장 후보, 김진태 강원지사 후보, 이정현 전남광주통합특별시장 후보 등 국민의힘 광역단체장 후보들도 이날 서울 종로구 보신각 앞에서 기자회견을 열고 “‘이재명 셀프 면죄, 반헌법 공소 취소’를 위한 특검법 발의를 전면 중단하라”는 결의문을 발표했다.)

The Democratic Party stated on the same day that it would hold internal discussions regarding the timing of handling the fabricated indictment special counsel bill. Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae met with reporters after a campaign rally in Dongducheon, Gyeonggi Province, and said, “The party and the presidential office need to coordinate,” adding, “We will gather the collective opinions of the people, party members, and lawmakers to make the best choice.” Floor spokesperson Kim Hyun-jung also appeared on KBS radio’s “Jeongyeok Sisa” and stated, “We will decide after a process of deliberation through meetings of the leadership, standing committees, and the general assembly of lawmakers.” Regarding the succession of condemnation messages from conservative opposition regional leadership candidates, spokesperson Kim said, “I think it might be to cover up the controversy over the ‘Yoon Again’ nominations.” (민주당은 이날 조작기소 특검법 처리 시점에 대해 내부 논의를 거치겠다고 밝혔다. 정청래 대표는 경기도 동두천시 유세 뒤 기자들을 만나 “당·청이 조율해야 한다”며 “국민과 당원, 국회의원들의 총의를 모아 가장 좋은 선택을 하겠다”고 말했다. 김현정 원내대변인도 한국방송(KBS) 라디오 ‘전격시사’에 출연해 “소위, 상임위, 의원총회 등의 과정들을 통해 숙의하는 과정을 거쳐 결정할 것”이라고 했다. 김 대변인은 보수 야권 광역자치단체장 후보들이 잇달아 규탄 메시지를 내는 것에 대해서는 “‘윤 어게인’ 공천 논란을 덮기 위해 하는 것 아닌가란 생각”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Lee Gwang-jae: "I Will Be the Link Between Hanam, Gyeonggi, and the Government… The People's Power Party Must Change by Judging 'Yoon Again'" (이광재 “하남·경기·정부 연결고리 될 것…‘윤어게인’ 심판해야 국힘 변화”)
item.description:
"Hanam has many local issues and a large moderate conservative population. I am the only candidate who can be persuasive to conservative voters." (“하남은 지역 현안이 많고 중도 보수층도 많아요. 보수 유권자들에게 설득력이 있는 후보는 저밖에 없습니다.”)

Lee Gwang-jae, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for the parliamentary by-election in Gyeonggi Hanam-gap, which will be held alongside the June 3 local elections, said this in an interview at a café in Sinjang-dong, Hanam. Hanam-gap was a tight race in the last general election, where then-candidate Choo Mi-ae narrowly defeated People's Power Party candidate Lee Yong by 1,199 votes. ( 6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 경기 하남갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 이광재 더불어민주당 후보는 하남시 신장동 한 카페에서 한 인터뷰에서 이렇게 말했다. 하남갑은 지난 총선에서 당시 추미애 후보가 이용 국민의힘 후보에게 1199표 차로 신승한 접전지다.)

A three-term lawmaker who also served as Gangwon Province Governor and, until recently, chaired the Democratic Party's local branch in Bundang-gap, Seongnam, he stated, "Hanam-gap is geographically close to Bundang and Gangwon, so it's not unfamiliar to me. If elected, I will firmly establish roots here." Regarding his opponent being former People's Power Party lawmaker Lee Yong, who was dubbed the 'bodyguard' of former President Yoon Suk-yeol, he said, "If 'Yoon Again' gains strength, healthy conservatism will be pushed out, and politics in Yeouido will become a battlefield. The people must judge and force the People's Power Party to part ways with former President Yoon Suk-yeol." <<> ― Why did you decide to run in Hanam-gap? <<> "The region's demand and the party's request were for someone who would settle in Hanam and resolve local issues, a candidate persuasive to moderate conservatives. Hanam has great growth potential and is right next to Gangwon and Bundang (where I chaired the local branch), so it felt familiar." <<> ― Did you decline to run in Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul because of Cho Kuk of the Rebuilding Korea Party, who is running there? <<> "Candidate Cho is someone who has worked hard for prosecution reform and regime change. Even if we have differences in thinking, I thought it wasn't right for me to run there." <<> ― Hanam-gap is known for its strong conservative leanings. <<> "There is a mix of disappointment over Representative Choo Mi-ae leaving the district and expectations that if she becomes Gyeonggi Governor, she will provide full support to Hanam. If I am elected, there will be a strong link connecting Hanam, the government, Gyeonggi Province, and the National Assembly, involving President Lee Jae-myung (a former Gyeonggi Governor) and Gyeonggi Governor Choo Mi-ae (who will be from Hanam-gap if elected)." <<> ― If elected, what is your top priority? <<> "Solving transportation issues. I need to secure the budget for the swift start of construction on the Hanam sections of Line 3 (Songpa-Hanam Line) and Line 9 (Gangdong-Hanam Line) in the 3rd new town Gyo-san district. I will also rapidly push for the extension of GTX-D and Wirye-Sinsa Line to Hanam. We also need to resolve the absurdity where school districts change across a single street, between Songpa, Seongnam, and Hanam." <<> ― There is criticism that you were suddenly nominated and don't know the local conditions of Hanam well. <<> "Knowing the region well doesn't just mean being aware of the issues. It involves knowing the path to resolution and actually moving the National Assembly and the government to achieve it. Even when I was outside the Assembly, I resolved the issue of the Seongnam airfield height restrictions, which had remained unresolved for 15 years, by bringing sitting lawmakers to Bundang." <<> ― How do you assess your opponent, People's Power Party candidate Lee Yong? <<> "The People's Power Party showed through this nomination that it is incapable of self-correction. The people must judge so that the People's Power Party can part ways with former President Yoon and become a healthy conservative party. If the People's Power Party does not become a healthy conservative force, South Korea will fall into a state of quasi-civil war." <<> ― The special counsel investigation into fabricated prosecutions proposed by the Democratic Party could become a variable in the local elections. <<> "A parliamentary investigation has already confirmed excessive investigations and indictments by the prosecution. Isn't it right to conduct a fact-finding through a special counsel and hear the public's judgment? (The timing of the special counsel) is an issue for the party to decide, but the elections are in full swing. The public is more interested in economic issues than politics." <<> By Go Han-sol and Jeong Hye-min, reporters sol@hani.co.kr ( 3선 의원 출신으로 강원지사를 지내고 직전까지 민주당 성남시 분당갑 지역위원장을 맡았던 그는 “하남갑은 지역적으로 분당과 강원 옆이라 낯설지 않다”며 “당선되면 이곳에 확실히 뿌리를 내릴 것”이라고 말했다. 상대가 윤석열 전 대통령의 ‘호위무사’로 불렸던 이용 전 국민의힘 의원인 점에 관해서는 “‘윤 어게인’이 힘을 받으면 건강한 보수가 쫓겨나고, 여의도 정치는 전장이 된다”며 “국민이 심판해 국민의힘이 윤석열 전 대통령과 결별하게 해줘야 한다”고 말했다.)
